# gbarecomp-keyinput-v1
# frame,keyinput_active_low
#
# AW2 campaign prologue text-advance route.
# Prologue is a multi-page text crawl; each A press advances one page.
# Title at ~3600, START, then a long series of A taps.

0,0x03FF

# START from title
3800,0x03F7
3820,0x03FF

# A → Campaign
4200,0x03FE
4220,0x03FF

# A taps to advance prologue pages (every 40 frames)
